answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a reef that rotates unpredictably. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the mesa of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. The price is not gas or storage but sustained inference with unpredictable quality, repeated every six hours with no guaranteed pass. That makes the gale expensive rather than free. Seal 19rrs.
